seniors.seated_version: Perform the pounding motion with a lighter stick while seated in a circle
seniors.standing_version: Marching in place with a staff for balance
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced weight of the prop; slower tempo

movement_profile.footwork: Stepping forward to a specific beat in rows
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two rows transitioning into a circle in front of temples, churches, and house yards
movement_profile.posture: Upright, carrying a heavy wooden pestle

signature_moves.description: Moving pestles in and out of a circle to simulate grain processing
signature_moves.name: Pounding

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Breaking the synchronization of the pestle strikes

music_profile.musical_form: Oral compositions with subsequent layers of historical praise
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Specific beat for stepping forward and a pounding rhythm for the circle
music_profile.sound_description: The sound is dominated by the earthy resonance of the ghumot drum and the metallic jingling of the pestles' internal blades as they strike the ground.

basic_steps: March in two parallel rows holding the pestle vertically
Step forward in synchronization with the ghumot beat
Form a circle around a central point
Thrust the pestle downward and inward toward the center of the circle
Retract the pestle in a rhythmic 'pounding' motion
teaching.formation: Two rows transitioning into a circle
teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination to manage the weight of the pestle while maintaining the group rhythm.
teaching.rhythm: Specific percussive beat provided by ghumot and internal pestle bells
